title: YouTube Transcript Scraper
description: Extract transcripts from YouTube videos, channels, or search results. Pick one input mode below.

videoUrls.title: Video URLs
videoUrls.description: One or more YouTube video URLs. Supports youtube.com/watch, youtu.be, Shorts, and embed links.
videoUrls.sectionDescription: Enter Video URLs, a Channel URL, OR a Search Query. If multiple are filled, priority is: URLs > Channel > Search.

channelUrl.title: Channel URL or @handle
channelUrl.description: A YouTube channel URL or @handle (e.g. @mkbhd). Extracts transcripts from the channel's videos.

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Search YouTube by keyword and extract transcripts from the top results.
searchQuery.prefill: how to use ChatGPT for business

maxResults.title: Max videos
maxResults.description: Maximum number of videos to process. Default 10.
maxResults.sectionDescription: Control how many videos to process and optionally filter by date.

language.title: Transcript language
language.description: Preferred transcript language (ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Falls back to English if unavailable.

dateFrom.title: Published after
dateFrom.description: Only include videos published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Channel and search modes only.

dateTo.title: Published before
dateTo.description: Only include videos published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Channel and search modes only.

includeMetadata.title: Include video metadata
includeMetadata.description: Fetch title, views, likes, channel info, tags, and thumbnail. Disable for faster runs if you only need transcript text.
includeMetadata.sectionDescription: Choose what data to include in results.

outputFormat.title: Transcript format
outputFormat.description: Which transcript formats to return: 'all' (segments + plain text + SRT + LLM context), 'segments' (timestamped only), 'plain_text' (text + LLM context), or 'srt' (subtitle format).

customProxyUrl.title: Custom proxy URL
customProxyUrl.description: Optional rotating residential proxy (e.g. http://user:pass@host:port). Overrides Apify proxy if set.
customProxyUrl.sectionDescription: YouTube requires residential proxies. Apify residential proxy is used by default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Apify proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Residential proxy is required — datacenter IPs are blocked by YouTube.
